title: Generated Artifact Metadata Authority Apply
problem: Accepted metadata Generated Artifacts are staged for Metadata Authority apply, but Nako has no redacted apply-plan, audited apply route, or Web Admin confirmation workflow that turns them into Canonical Metadata through host policy.
gates: npm --prefix web run test -- src/test/route-contracts.test.tsx src/test/route-state-contracts.test.tsx

evidence.summary: Opened the Metadata Authority apply lane after auditing Generated Artifact acceptance, Admin API redaction, server MetadataApplication, NFO apply lifecycle, and Web review mutation closeout.

Added a read-only Admin metadata apply-plan contract for accepted metadata Generated Artifacts, including redacted field summaries, field actions, no-mutation app and HTTP route tests, and final route documentation.

Added host-owned app-layer metadata apply execution for accepted Generated Artifacts, all-lock MetadataApplication policy, atomic metadata application item/projection commit, stale-target rejection, redacted apply results, idempotent no-op replay, and focused server plus SQLite DB contract evidence.

Added durable Generated Artifact metadata apply outcomes with explicit idempotency keys, SQLite/PostgreSQL schema parity, atomic outcome plus metadata application commit, replay of persisted applied/noop outcomes, failed outcome audit, and focused SQLite/PostgreSQL/server evidence.

Exposed the final Admin Generated Artifact metadata apply route, added redacted apply request/response DTOs, covered auth/body/error/replay HTTP behavior, and synchronized generated Admin TypeScript contracts for Web clients.
